grade.notes: Scoring is separated for initial settlement performance, audit selection, and post-payload final performance; no overall winner score is assigned. The initial response correctly identifies both D_now+ authority/freshness substitution and identity/idempotency mismatch from evidence available before the audit index, while avoiding overreaction to D_now0 parser, warning, and retry-only items. The audit selection retrieved the two strongest discriminators for the core blockers. Post-audit confirmation was represented as strengthening the reject/repair judgment rather than inventing new confirmed harms. High-confidence unsupported acceptance is not flagged because neither initial nor final accepted the implementation; confidence was reported low and evidence sufficiency insufficient. Remaining uncertainties were properly preserved. Volume and elapsed time were not treated as cognitive effort.
